title: Continuous
body:
Varying smoothly, with a value at every point and infinitely many possible values between
any two. What makes a signal [[Analog]]. Opposite of [[Discrete]].

Not the same word as [[Continuity]] in [[CALCULUS 1]], which is a property a *function* has at a
*point* (no hole, no jump). This note is about the range of values a signal can take; that one is
about whether a graph can be drawn without lifting the pen.
